A.flow: A: the customer comes to the business (video or phone count as A)

services.name: Drop-in play, one child
services.story: The main story: drop-in play for one child, $35, Sat 11:00am to 2:00pm. A card is saved for the club's $20 fee. Alex pays at the desk at pick-up.

services.name: Saturday play camp with lunch
services.story: Saturday play camp with lunch for one child, $55, 11:00am to 2:00pm, paid in full when booking.

B.flow: B: the business goes to the customer

services.name: Evening sitting, two children (4½ hours)
services.story: The main story: Taylor sits Thu 6:00 to 10:30pm, $24 an hour for two children: $108. A card is saved for the $72 late-cancel fee. Rosie texts the bill when Taylor texts DONE; Alex replies 1 or pays on the page, with a tip.

services.name: Evening sitting, two children (4½ hours)
services.story: The same sitting. The saved card is charged $108 when Taylor texts DONE, plus any extra time Taylor agreed to stay.

questions_before_times: The start and end time, or which session at the play room
Just this time, or a plan (like after school, Mon to Fri)
Will the sitter drive anyone? (needs the owner's OK)
safety_stop: A child hurt, missing, alone, not breathing or choking
A report of harm to a child, by anyone
A sick child (fever, vomiting) before a sitting
license: Usually none for a sitter in a family's home. A play room where parents leave children (drop-in child care) needs a child-care license where the state's rules require it. The state form says which.
